projects.title: ScamShield — AI Scam Risk Analyzer
projects.shortDescription: A free, open-source scam-risk analyzer for emails, SMS, WhatsApp forwards, payment requests, and QR codes.
projects.fullDescription: ScamShield is an open-source security intelligence application engineered to evaluate suspicious communications before users fall victim to financial or identity fraud. Rather than relying on a single opaque LLM call, ScamShield pairs a deterministic heuristic rule engine with an LLM verification layer — where the more cautious verdict always wins. Every flag isolates observed evidence (quoted directly from the user's input) and highlights exact phrases in real time. For uncompromising user privacy, scan history is encrypted locally using AES-256-GCM with non-extractable keys in browser IndexedDB, leaving zero sensitive data on any external server.
features: Deterministic rule engine + LLM merged verdict with zero fake statistics
Exact trigger highlighting isolating suspicious phrases in original message
Client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted scan history in IndexedDB (non-extractable key)
Regional pattern packs for UPI/KYC, ECOWAS, LATAM, and CN scam vocabularies
Installable Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline capabilities
challenges: Preventing false confidence and AI hallucinations on subtle phishing vectors
Securing sensitive scan history without creating backend privacy liabilities
Achieving instant sub-350ms analysis without waiting on heavy cloud roundtrips
solutions: Designed a dual-engine architecture: local deterministic heuristics execute instantly, followed by hedged LLM verification
Implemented client-side cryptography via Web Crypto API with non-extractable AES-GCM keys
Packaged as a lightweight PWA with local service worker caching for near-instant cold starts

projects.title: Hospital Management System (HMS)
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack healthcare operations platform featuring secure role-based portals for Admins, Doctors, and Patients.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive, multi-portal hospital operating system engineered to streamline patient appointment scheduling, staff coordination, and medical history tracking. Developed as part of Modern Application Development (MAD 1), HMS enforces strict role-based access control (RBAC) across three distinct portals: an Admin dashboard for staff CRUD and clinic telemetry, a Doctor workspace for 7-day schedule management and treatment logging, and a self-service Patient portal with real-time doctor search, slot reservation, and automated double-booking prevention.
features: Three isolated role-based portals (Admin, Doctor, Patient) with session-based authentication
Real-time doctor discovery filtered by department, specialization, and 7-day availability
Zero-conflict appointment scheduling engine preventing double-booking overlaps
Comprehensive diagnosis, prescription, and treatment note logging against completed visits
Dual-backend architecture bridging Flask/FastAPI with SQLite and modern Next.js frontend
challenges: Preventing race conditions and concurrent double-booking of doctor time slots
Enforcing strict data access boundaries between doctor records and patient histories
Managing relational database integrity with dynamic doctor availability windows
solutions: Implemented atomic database transactions and slot validation rules at the ORM layer
Designed normalized relational schemas in SQLAlchemy with indexing on doctor IDs and timestamps

projects.title: Recon-Agent (GST AI Engine)
projects.shortDescription: Autonomous multi-agent GST Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation & recovery engine built for AWS First Commit 2026.
projects.fullDescription: Recon-Agent is an autonomous compliance intelligence platform built for the WeMakeDevs AWS First Commit 2026 hackathon. It automates GST Input Tax Credit recovery under Indian GST Rule 88D and Section 16(2)(aa). Orchestrated using AWS Bedrock foundation models and the Strands agentic SDK, the system continuously ingests GSTR-2B vs GSTR-3B filings, detects invoice discrepancies, calculates tax liability deltas, and dispatches multi-channel supplier follow-ups with immutable DynamoDB audit trails.
features: Autonomous multi-agent reconciliation pipeline matching purchase registers against GST portal fixtures
Strict regulatory compliance engine encoding GST Rule 88D and Section 16(2)(aa) constraints
AWS Bedrock LLM integration for automated discrepancy justification and supplier recovery drafts
Dual-surface frontend: responsive React 19 + Vite product dashboard and Streamlit compliance console
FastAPI orchestration gateway with DynamoDB audit logging for end-to-end trace verification
challenges: Processing high-volume tabular tax filings without losing precision or hallucinating deltas
Unifying two different interfaces (Streamlit console and React dashboard) to a single backend source of truth
Orchestrating multi-agent state machines reliably within cloud latency targets
solutions: Separated deterministic ledger math from LLM explanation: all deltas computed programmatically
Built a centralized /api/dispatch gateway in FastAPI consumed equally by both frontend surfaces
Integrated Strands SDK agent loops with structured JSON schemas and fallback engines for zero-cloud offline demos

projects.title: B2B Vendor Compliance Platform
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise vendor risk and compliance onboarding platform built during Semester 1 OJT at Polaris School of Technology.
projects.fullDescription: Developed as a 1-month intensive project during Semester 1 On-Job-Training (OJT) at Polaris School of Technology. The platform replaces fragmented email onboarding workflows with a centralized compliance portal. It automates vendor credential verification, monitors document expiration dates, and calculates operational risk scores without relying on bulky external frameworks or complex database dependencies.
features: Centralized vendor risk dashboard with real-time compliance scoring and document status badges
Automated expiration monitoring system generating proactive renewal alerts
Client-side reactive state machine handling multi-step vendor approval lifecycles
Zero-dependency architecture proving enterprise logic execution with vanilla JavaScript and Bootstrap 5
Audit log viewer tracking compliance transitions and submission milestones
challenges: Maintaining complex multi-step enterprise approval state without a backend server
Validating multifaceted vendor tax, legal, and operational documents with clean UX
Ensuring rapid client-side search and filtering across simulated vendor directories
solutions: Engineered an event-driven state machine stored in structured browser local storage with transactional updates
Designed a modular validation schema validating GSTIN, PAN, and certificate expiry dates
Implemented debounced DOM search queries rendering instantaneous UI updates
